author: Nintendo of America
description:
My Mario is a collection of products designed for young children and their parents to enjoy together! Select products from the My Mario collection are now available at Nintendo NEW YORK, Nintendo SAN FRANCISCO and select retailers.  

You can also download the free “Hello, Mario!” app that lets children and parents playfully interact with Mario. Check it out on the Apple App Store, Google Play and Nintendo eShop! 

Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/my-mario/?utm_source=Other&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=N0099-01&utm_id=N0099-01

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game is available now on Nintendo eShop. The physical version launches April 16, 2026, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/xenoblade-chronicles-x-definitive-edition-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW-AA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=N1146-01&utm_id=N1146-01

Join up with BLADE to explore the planet Mira and help bring humanity back from the edge of extinction, now with a faster frame rate (up to 60 fps) and enhanced resolution (up to 4K).

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game by purchasing the upgrade pack.
